format: C# ASP.NET Web Forms (Code-behind for .aspx page)
description: This file contains the server-side logic for the TheoryExam page, including loading questions from a database, handling user navigation, submitting answers, and managing the exam timer.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam ASP.NET page, managing exam question loading, timing, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the loading of the page, initializes questions, checks login session, and sets up the timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the course name based on the course ID.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles the submission of exam answers, storing responses in the database and updating queues.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles timer expiry.
